[i][u][b]The Free Press of Argos Time[/b][/u]

Independent Daily News from the Oceanic Enclave Republic
New Levbkurg | HST+3 | 602-562-8902 | 21 Feb, 2026
By Harro Vennik, Political Correspondent

Berlienwerk, OER  In a moment described by officials as a turning point for regional diplomacy, President Ironvisak Willham welcomed Representative Minister Wallace H. Achebe of the United Lavian Republic to the Oceanic Enclave Republics capital for the first-ever official ministerial visit.

Minister Achebes arrival was marked with a ceremonial welcome. His aircraft, designated Air Force One of the ULR, touched down near the Berlienwerk Military Port, escorted by a formation of two Eurofighter Typhoon 3500-X and four Eurofighter Typhoon 3000 jets.

As the Minister stepped onto the tarmac, President Willham greeted him with a firm handshake before the two leaders walked together toward assembled crowds, waving as photographers captured the moment. The arrival ceremony reached its climax when four KF-22 fighters and a B25-ELXS stealth bomber roared overhead in a dazzling aerial display, showcasing the might of the Enclave Air Force.
After the display, President Willham and Minister Achebe traveled by motorcade to the Gate of Berlienwerk, the nations Capitol Building, before entering the Presidents personal office to begin formal talks.

[b]Peace and Petroleum Cooperation[/b]

According to official communiqués, discussions centered on regional peace and economic cooperation. The highlight was the proposed establishment of the ArgosShamat Petroleum Organization or  ASPO, an energy consortium first advanced by the United Lavian Republic.

President Willham confirmed his agreement to ULRs framework, signaling Oceanic's readiness to participate in a joint formation that could regulate petroleum production, stabilize prices, and secure long-term energy partnerships across Argos.

This is not only an economic pact but a peace initiative, President Willham stated. Through ASPO, we will strengthen stability and prosperity across the region.
Minister Achebe echoed the sentiment, noting that Lavian and Oceanic cooperation could set the foundation for a new era of trust and mutual growth.

[quote=united_hydronia;60402436]News of Sikrisk's mysterious situation in their arctic territories were quickly brought forth to Hydronia's newly elected conservative government. President Seliban would approve the deployment of the SAB arctic special forces unit, more commonly known as the snow wolves, alongside a team of specialist arctic researchers to Sikirsk & their arctic territories to assist in the investigation of the mysterious happenings. This would be done through an order passed by the assembly on 28th January 2026. The unit would arrive at sikirsk by the 2nd February.

Additionally, a satellite would be diverted to view the arctic from above. The images would sent to the Hydronian arctic department, a constituent department of the ministry of environmental affairs, for inspection, before handing data over to the three administrative committees of the three unfederated arctic territories for experimentation and investigation. The details of the investigation are yet to be made public...[/quote]

[i]To the Government of [nation]United Hydronia[/nation],
[/i]On behalf of the Federatsiya, we acknowledge and accept your discreet offer of assistance regarding the unexplained "[i]developments[/i]" within our Arctic territories. The deployment of your Snow Wolves arctic unit, alongside specialist researchers, will be coordinated through the [nation]Sikirskian Colonial Administration[/nation]. Sikirsk greatly values Hydronias commitment to allied cooperation matters. Information and imagery from your redirected satellite will be received by our Arctic Department for parallel review. We stress that all findings remain within the channels of our two governments until greater clarity has been established. Sikirsk itself will also deploy similar measures soon.

[b]Signed,
Marshal-President John Mitarski
On behalf of the Council of the Federation[/b]

[b]Continuation of Government Briefing

Following the Hydronian response, the Colonial Administration has ordered an immediate expansion of the search perimeter around the last known coordinates of the missing expedition leader. Units of the Sikirskian Polar Guard, supported by unmanned drones, have begun wide-sweep operations. Early reports describe unusual ice formations and unexplained disruptions in radio signals within the area.

[i]The House of Delegates[/i] has requested updates every 48 hours, but at this stage, the [i]Council of the Federation[/i] has agreed that details will remain classified, with only essential information shared publicly. Coordination with Hydronias incoming forces is expected to begin within the next seventy-two hours.
